Create all 26 uppercase letters A–Z exactly once, arranged in a precise, evenly spaced grid on a square canvas. Render each letter in a fun, glossy, bubbly retro display font with consistent scale and a distinct Christmas-themed pattern—such as plaid, polka dots, candy-cane stripes, metallic tinsel, or ornaments—plus polished highlights and subtle dimensional depth. Keep the composition centered, clean, and balanced on a pure white background; include no extra objects, cast shadows, or text beyond the letters.

The cat wears a burlap hat adorned with a sunflower and fall leaves, a plaid shirt, and denim overalls. Around the cat are pumpkins of various sizes, and a small wooden sign reads "Pumpkin Spice And Everything Nice." To the right of the scarecrow, text in a decorative font says "Leaves are falling Coffee is calling." The overall image has a warm, cozy, and autumnal feel and is islolated on a white background.
